comment: A big ballpark like Doral is much more suited to Young’s strengths than Harbour Town. Look for him to pick up right where he left off with his near double-dip across TPC Sawgrass and Augusta National.
Gotta start zigging! Only two golfers have beaten him in his previous two outings. On an unfamiliar track, I'm going to ride the guy who hits it the best and hope his putter stays hot.
If you’re like me and haven’t used Scheffler yet in Segment 2, there’s no reason to leave him off your roster this week. Surely something has to go right for him very soon.
Won’t be scared off because of the back injury any longer. He’s finished T7 and T4 in his last two starts despite the concerns and had a full week to recover and get ready for this stretch.
To tame the Blue Monster one needs both power and control off the tee, so going with the man who slayed a similar water-laiden dragon at TPC Sawgrass just a few weeks ago.
